checklist_name: WCAG 2.1 Level AA & Mobile Ergonomics Checklist

items.description: All interactive elements (buttons, links, icons, chip filters) must measure at least 44x44px on touch viewports (< 768px).
Adjacent interactive controls must have at least 8px physical spacing to prevent erroneous taps.
Body copy and text below 18pt (or 14pt bold) must maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast against surface background.
Headings, large text, and interactive UI boundaries (input borders, toggles) must maintain minimum 3:1 contrast.
Page structure must contain exactly one <main> landmark, plus <nav>, <header>, and <footer> sections.
Exactly one <h1> must exist per route. Heading levels (h2-h6) must not skip numerical order.
items.wcag_reference: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 2.4.6 Headings and Labels

items.description: Keyboard focus indicators must remain distinctly visible on all focusable elements without suppression via outline:none.
Active modal dialogs, drawers, and bottom sheets must trap Tab focus within the dialog bounds.
